output.data_choice: P-1132 is a free USD project (Polar Marine Oy, rate 1.0835, standard VAT 25.5%) with one 42.50 EUR line. A 2.72 EUR write-up makes the converted line 48.99587 USD, which rounds to 49.00. VAT on the rounded line is 12.50, but VAT on the unrounded amount would be 12.49, so the BILL-1203 defect would show again if it came back.
